'''B'karitz''' was a member of the [[Schenor]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. He was a [[nest-guildmaster]]. When [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]]s brought him evidence of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] complicity in a [[Massacre at the Schenor research station|massacre]] at a [[Schenor research station]], B'karitz declared their [[Schenor/Imperial treaty|treaty]] with the Empire to be null and void.

==Biography==
B'kartiz was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Schenor]] who was the [[nest-guildmaster]] of a powerful province on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Rhamsis Callo]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[operative]]s arrived at his [[nest-guild]], bringing a juvenile Schenor, [[A'kazz]], with them. A'kazz was the sole survivor of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-backed [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Massacre at the Schenor research station|assault]] on a [[Schenor research station]]. Initially believing the Rebels to have kidnapped A'kazz and to be demanding ransom for him, B'karitz was eventually convinced of their good intentions and [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathically]] interrogated the youth. Upon learning the truth, he vowed to drive the Empire from Rhamsis Callo.<ref name="Silent" />

Meeting with the [[Unidentified Imperial ambassador to Rhamsis Callo|Imperial ambassador]] at a [[Unidentified Imperial base (Rhamsis Callo)|base]] under construction at [[Chafflock]] under an [[Schenor/Imperial treaty|agreement]] between the Schenor government and the Empire, B'karitz declared the treaty dissolved due to the Empire's actions. Despite professing their innocence, the Imperials attacked B'karitz and his [[nest-warrior]]s. The Alliance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] helped the nest-guildmaster to escape the ambush, and allowed him to rally support from other Schenor [[Noble/Legends|nobles]].<ref name="Silent" />
